description: This file is a core implementation of the BORIS (Behavioral Observation Research Interactive Software) project. It includes the main application window, GUI setup, media control, plotting routines, project management, update checks, and other core functionalities essential for observing and analyzing behavioral data. The code utilizes various libraries for GUI (PySide6), media handling, plotting (matplotlib), image processing (PIL), and project-specific modules, indicating it manages a complex interactive desktop application for behavioral research.
